Gentle Giants Draft Horse Rescue is a 501c(3) Equine Welfare Organization committed to saving draft and draft cross horses from slaughter, abuse, and neglect. We’ve rescued over 2,000 horses since we were founded in 2005. 

For those less likely to be adopted, we offer lifetime sanctuary at our 300+ acre facility in Maryland. We house over 200 horses at a time and bring over 350 horses to safety each year. Gentle Giants continues to be one of the loudest national voices fighting to permanently end the slaughter of U.S. horses for human consumption. 

We are located in Mount Airy, Maryland, USA and are open for tours by appointment. Please email tours@gentlegiants.org to visit the farm and meet your favorite gentle giant(s)!
